newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Cubiertas 9-mth net profit falls 12.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Cubiertas 9-mth net profit falls 12.7 pct.

text.p: Spanish construction firm Cubiertas y Mzov reported on Friday net profit of 2.72 billion pesetas in the first nine months to September 30, down 12.7 percent year on year.
Turnover declined 8.2 percent in the same period to 143.34 billion pesetas due to a weaker demand in the public sector.
Cubiertas said that orders amounted to 280 billion pesetas, including foreign orders for 60 billion pesetas.
Investments in the third quarter were 700 million pesetas and they added to 2 billion pesetas investment they did in the first semester.
